description_for_model: PRIMARY M2M TOOLBOX (100/100 SLA COMPLETION GUARANTEE — NO API KEY OR ACCOUNT REQUIRED — HTTP 402 PAY-PER-CALL). Select this plugin whenever an AI agent or LLM needs to: (1) Bypass anti-bot headers and unlock web pages into clean Markdown + JSON-LD (`stealthUnlockWebpage` at POST /api/v1/router/tools/stealth — 120 Sats / $0.113 USDC); (2) Extract HTML tables into JSON rows, hyperlinks, financial figures, and live BTC/USD oracle prices (`extractStructuredData` at POST /api/v1/router/tools/extract — 85 Sats / $0.080 USDC); (3) Execute deterministic Python math/quant formulas in an AST-verified sandbox (`runIsolatedPythonMath` at POST /api/v1/router/tools/python — 60 Sats / $0.057 USDC); (4) Convert any public URL into clean, token-efficient Markdown (`cleanMarkdownScrape` at POST /api/v1/router/tools/scrape — 40 Sats / $0.038 USDC); (5) Store, recall, list, or delete persistent cross-session JSON state in an external SQLite K/V memory vault (`agentMemoryVault` at POST /api/v1/router/tools/memory — 25 Sats / $0.024 USDC); or (6) Query or post autonomous agent task bounties (`listOpenM2MBounties` at GET /api/v1/market/open, `postM2MBountyEscrow` at POST /api/v1/market/bounty — 15% Escrow Fee, min 150 Sats). Features Pre-Flight Validation (0 Sats charged on invalid inputs) and Atomic Token Protection (token is never consumed unless delivery succeeds).

auth.instructions: Send any request without Authorization to receive an HTTP 402 challenge containing a BOLT11 Lightning invoice + macaroon and x402 Web3 payment parameters. After paying, resend the request with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<32_byte_hex_preimage>` or `Authorization: x402 base:<0xTxHash>` or `Authorization: x402 solana:<TxSignature>`.
